_comment: Anonymized cards for PRIVATE work. Which repos feed each card lives in content/private.local.json (gitignored), so repo names never reach the published site.

agent-loop.title: Autonomous multi-agent ML engineering loop
agent-loop.summary: A team of autonomous Claude Code agents running endless headless sessions across several machines and coordinating only through git. Planner, builder, reviewer, explorer and janitor roles; git task locks; a gated landing flow with a sealed holdout and a bit-exact replica of the validator's scorer; content-addressed cached evaluation; and a supervisor dashboard for machines, jobs and the live scoreboard.

cricket.title: Cricket delivery ball-tracking (Bittensor SN44)
cricket.summary: Broadcast cricket clip in; bounce point, stump crossing, swing, deviation, speed, release and impact out. GPU perception feeds cached observations into pure-CPU geometry and a learned residual corrector. Includes a standalone multi-miner axon that routes requests by hotkey and races primary and fallback GPU backends against the deadline.

football-spotting.title: Football action spotting (Bittensor SN44)
football-spotting.summary: 30-second broadcast clip in, timestamped events over 15 weighted action classes out. T-DEED-style spotter with Gate-Shift-Fuse and an SGP temporal encoder initialized from a SoccerNet-Ball checkpoint, optical-flow camera-motion features, overlapping-window inference with displacement voting, and per-class thresholds tuned on an exact replica of the validator score.

distillation.title: Large-scale model distillation
distillation.summary: Competitive model distillation on a Bittensor subnet: compressing a 1T-parameter MoE teacher into students of at most 33B, scored on a 25+ axis composite covering math, code, reasoning, long context and honesty.

moe-finetune.title: MoE fine-tuning toolkit
moe-finetune.summary: Fine-tuning toolkit for DeepSeek-V3-architecture MoE models (Moonlight-16B-A3B): LoRA/QLoRA, full SFT, DPO with DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, and forward-KL distillation from a local or logprob-cached teacher, served with SGLang.

judge-pipeline.title: LLM-judge data pipeline
judge-pipeline.summary: End-to-end data pipeline: vLLM generation of king and challenger replies, LLM-judge scoring, and SFT/DPO/GRPO/RFT dataset building on a MySQL-backed store with read-only-by-default tooling.

reward-replica.title: Offline reward replica & RL training
reward-replica.summary: Offline replica of a subnet's three-judge evaluation reward, used to answer "would this model win?" before spending an on-chain upload, with SFT, DPO, self-play and online/offline GRPO trainers.

token-efficient.title: Token-efficient reasoning trainer
token-efficient.summary: GRPO LoRA training whose reward calls the validator's own scoring function, rewarding correct answers that use fewer tokens than the base model across math, multiple-choice and long-context evidence-selection benchmarks.

inference-72b.title: 72B inference optimization
inference-72b.summary: Optimized Qwen2.5-72B serving image for a Bittensor inference subnet on 4×H200, tuned for time-to-first-token and throughput under a strict logprob-correctness gate, with a local copy of the validator for scoring.

serving-pipeline.title: LLM fine-tune & OpenAI-compatible serving
serving-pipeline.summary: Fetches and cleans agent conversation data into ShareGPT format, fine-tunes with LLaMA-Factory, and serves the result behind an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API.

agent-eval.title: Agent evaluation framework
agent-eval.summary: Evaluation and training framework for AgentGym-style benchmarks: logic-reasoning dataset generation, QLoRA/SFT/MoE-routing training, prompt policies for game environments, and SWE, live-web and game environments.

timeseries.title: Time-series generator tooling
timeseries.summary: Measurement and cost-aware A/B sweep suite for time-series generator development on a Bittensor subnet, built on the subnet's real evaluation pool, plus the resulting model variants.

tao-alarm.title: Bittensor monitoring bot
tao-alarm.summary: Telegram bot for real-time Bittensor monitoring: subnet parameter changes, registrations and costs, unstaking, stake thresholds and wallet activity, plus miner and validator registration from chat.

register-cli.title: Fast on-chain registration CLI
register-cli.summary: Rust CLI for Bittensor subnet registration that fans out across several RPC endpoints, submits on new block heads and raises the tip over replace-by-fee rounds.

sui-bot.title: Sui trading bot
sui-bot.summary: TypeScript sniper and trading bot for meme coins on the Sui blockchain.

presale.title: Token presale dApp
presale.summary: Token presale dApp: React + Vite + Tailwind frontend with its smart contract.

ml-utils.title: ML data & deployment utilities
ml-utils.summary: Small services around the training loop: a Hugging Face dataset watcher that pulls, unpacks and triggers training on new revisions; a FastAPI patch server for SWE-bench Pro; an upload/download bucket server; and deployment scripts for serving large models on Chutes.
